document_metadata.summary: Neil McCauley, a 42-year-old ex-convict, leads a professional crew specializing in high-stakes heists, lives an austere, mobile life, and enters a location wearing a stolen intern's coat.

chunks.content: A monolith with alienating foregrounds. A bus pulls in on Beverly. NEIL McCAULEY and a nurse get off. Neil carries a paper bag and wears white pants like a hospital attendant. Neil is an ice-cold professional: very big, very tough. At 42 his short black hair is graying. He spent eight years in McNeil and three in San Quentin. He got out and hit the street in 1987. Four of the McNeil years were spent in the hole. Neil's voice is street, but his language is precise like an engineer's. He's very careful and very good.
